mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below historical averages signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 3.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses below 3.5%, or the threshold is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate below historical thresholds signals coordinated monetary and labor market easing, amplifying equity market optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies are below thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle, a further decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% intensifies easing, reducing long-term interest rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS crosses below 3.5% during the regime, or the regime condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in monthly payroll employment exceeding 150,000 signifies a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the threshold is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in the industrial production index below 102 signals weakening supply-side demand, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 102, or the contraction is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 3.5% and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 24,000, it indicates dual easing in monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity market gains and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies are in the specified state, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening cycle, a rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals weakening demand, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the regime condition is not met.
